schema_version.description: This field identifies the approval record contract.

change_id.description: This identifier selects one exact proposed change.

decision.description: This field records the actual owner decision.

owner_identity_ref.description: This reference identifies the authenticated owner, not a model role.

source_statement_ref.description: This reference locates the actual explicit owner statement.

source_statement_sha256.description: This digest identifies the retained owner statement bytes.

artifact_sha256.description: This digest identifies the exact proposed artifact or change manifest.

allowed_paths.description: These exact paths bound the approved change.

allowed_use.description: This text states the exact approved use, not a general testing exemption.

environment.description: This field names the environment in the owner approval.

decided_at.description: This field records the actual owner decision time.

expires_at.description: This field records the stated expiry. Null requires explicit approval without expiry.
